name: RunPod General ComfyUI Worker
description:
### A flexible worker for running any ComfyUI workflow.

1.  **Upload your workflow**: Get your workflow in API format by clicking **'Save (API Format)'** in the ComfyUI interface.
2.  **Provide inputs**: Fill in the inputs below. You can optionally override prompts or other values directly without editing your JSON file, just provide the node ID to target.

workflow_json.description: Upload your ComfyUI workflow (API Format JSON).

prompt_node_id.description: The node ID of the positive prompt to override (e.g., '6'). Required if providing a prompt.

negative_prompt_node_id.description: The node ID of the negative prompt to override (e.g., '7'). Required if providing a negative prompt.

seed_node_id.description: The node ID of the KSampler or Seed node to override (e.g., '3'). Required if providing a seed.
